text: Long catch-up with Salma over coffee. She flies to Lahore on May 14 for her cousin's wedding and is dreading the eleven hour flight with the twins. Her husband Hassan is staying behind because of work. Text her Friday to say safe travels.
Alejandro passed his driving test this morning, third attempt! His sister Eva drove him there and was more nervous than he was. He's already talking about a road trip to Portugal next summer.
Henrik lives in Malmö now, works for a shipping firm doing logistics. Wife is called Zofia, two boys, both at the international school. He still supports Leeds somehow.

Jen's audition for the Royal Northern is next Tuesday. She's been practising the Brahms nonstop and barely sleeping. Her mum's driving her up the night before. Must send her a good luck message Monday evening.

Caught Arjun and Anjali at the station. They're off to Japan in a fortnight, two weeks, Tokyo then Kyoto. Anjali's never done a long haul flight and is a bit anxious about it. Arjun wants restaurant tips, ask Yuki.
Demi got her A level results today. Straight As, she's into Bristol for medicine. Her dad was crying on the phone apparently. Should get her a card before she goes in September.
Ethan's flight back from Sydney got cancelled so he's stuck in Singapore until Thursday. Not much I can do, but check in with him tomorrow.
Nora works at the hospice on Elm Road, nights mostly. Her partner Kiri is a primary teacher. They live above the bakery on Mill Lane with their dog Biscuit.

Thomas has his theory test on June 3rd. He failed the hazard perception bit last time and is properly stressed about it, his dad keeps nagging him too. If he passes he wants to book the practical for July before his cousins' trip to Spain on 7/20. I've offered to quiz him this weekend, Saturday morning at the library.
Quick one. Sean said the Lisbon trip is off, Jonah couldn't get the time off work. They're doing a long weekend in Cornwall instead, Sept 12th to 15th.

Vikram's mum had her cataract op Monday, she's recovering at his sister's place in Leicester and apparently being a terrible patient. He's flying to Delhi on 11/2 for a month regardless, partly work, partly his cousin's engagement party on the 9th. His wife Sinead and the kids aren't going this time, school. Ring him before he goes, maybe Sunday.
Abigail's daughter sits her eleven plus on Saturday. Abigail is more worked up than the kid is. Remind me to message Abigail Saturday afternoon to see how it went.
Ran into Paolo at the gym. He's from Turin originally, moved here about six years ago, works in IT at the council. Brother Aurelio still lives in Italy and runs the family restaurant.
Book the dentist for next week and renew passport before the March trip.

Kalani just got back from Hawaii, three weeks visiting her grandparents on Maui. Jet lag is brutal, she slept fourteen hours yesterday. Her grandad turns ninety on December 8, she's already planning to go back for it.
Hassan Haddad - Salma's husband - is an accountant at a firm in Canary Wharf. Grew up in Beirut, came over for uni. Quiet but very funny once he gets going.

Chantal has her final violin exam, grade 8, on Wednesday the 22nd. She keeps saying she's fine but clearly isn't, kept chewing her nails the whole time we talked. Her teacher thinks she'll walk it. Text Chantal Tuesday night, then again Wednesday after.

Caroline and her husband are celebrating twenty years in Santorini, flying out October 30th. Her mum Sinead is minding the kids for the week. Caroline mentioned she's been eyeing a waterproof camera for the trip, could be a good present.

Bao's results day for his master's is Friday. He reckons the dissertation went badly but he always says that. His girlfriend Yuki has booked them a cheap week in Crete straight after, either to celebrate or to recover, flying Sunday from Gatwick. He's already looking at jobs in Singapore if the grades are good. Don't forget to ask him how he got on.
Yuki Ito, works with Arjun at the design agency. Lives in Hackney with her flatmate. Learned she's a big climber, goes to the wall most evenings.
Andile flew to Johannesburg last night for his father's funeral. He'll be gone at least ten days. I should send flowers to his flat for when he gets back, maybe around the 28th.

Had a call with Natasha. Her son Jonah did his first piano recital on Sunday and nailed it. She's thinking of putting him in for his grade 1 in spring. Also she's off to Prague with her sister for a hen do on June 6th, back on the 9th.
Jen Walsh — 'Jenny' to her family — lives in Didsbury, works as a session musician. Her brother Sean is the one who did the Camino last year. Their parents are in Galway.
Need to pick up the travel adapters and sort currency before Thursday. Also check if the flight on 4/18 allows two bags.

Carlos is retaking his bar exam in February after missing the pass mark by two points. He seemed really down about it, says he's barely leaving the house to study. His girlfriend Demi is trying to get him out more. Worth inviting him for a pint next week.
Zofia's mum is flying in from Kraków next Tuesday and staying till Christmas. Zofia's a bit apprehensive, the flat is small and her mum has opinions. Henrik is doing all the airport runs.
Sinead mentioned Abigail's oldest got into Oxford, starts in October. Abigail is over the moon. Send her congratulations.

Adebayo's in Lagos until the 30th, family visit, first time back in five years. He said the flight was fine but the layover in Istanbul was nine hours and he slept on the floor by gate 14. His aunt is throwing a big party for him this weekend. His wife Chantal stayed here with the baby, she's finding it hard on her own. Pop round to see Chantal on Wednesday with some food.

Eva has her nursing OSCE on Monday. She's done three mock runs but still can't get the wound dressing station right. Her boyfriend Ethan is acting as her patient every night this week lol. Wish her luck Sunday.
Arjun Patel. Software engineer at a fintech, lives in Wembley with his parents and grandmother. Married to Anjali last year, they're house hunting near Harrow. He's vegetarian, she isn't.

Kiri's taking her driving test again on Nov 14. Last time she clipped the kerb on the parallel park. Nora says she's been out practising with her dad every evening. Maybe offer to take her out in my car this weekend too.
Got the itinerary through for our Iceland trip, flying out Friday morning, back the following Wednesday. Thomas is feeding the cat.
Paolo and his wife are flying to Buenos Aires next month for her brother's wedding. Long trip, 14 hours via Madrid. Their little one is only eighteen months and Paolo is worried about it.
Vikram's daughter Anjali had her grade 5 ballet exam yesterday. Results come out in about six weeks. Ask Vikram in December if she passed.

Sean's moving to Dublin for work in January. He's got a job with Google there, team lead. His girlfriend is staying in Manchester for now, they'll do long distance and see how it goes. His mum's thrilled he'll be closer to Galway. Leaving drinks are Friday December 19th at the Briton's Protection, I said I'd sort a card for everyone to sign.
Nothing major from lunch with Bao. He's still at the architecture firm, still in the flat in Ancoats. His sister Kiri lives near us apparently, in Chorlton.

Coffee with Salma and Kalani this morning. Kalani's auditioning for the touring cast of Les Mis on May 20, she's been working with a vocal coach since February. Salma's going to drive her to London for it. Kalani admitted she's terrified, it's the biggest audition she's done. Salma also mentioned she's taking the kids to Morocco over Easter, flying from Manchester on 4/2. Must text Kalani the night before the audition and check in with Salma once she's back from Morocco.
Aurelio is coming over from Turin for two weeks starting next Thursday. Paolo is taking him to Edinburgh at the weekend. Aurelio loves single malt so maybe a bottle for him as a welcome gift.
Jonah sat his CFA level 2 on Saturday. Says he ran out of time on the last section. Results not out until the end of August. He's not hopeful.

Natasha said her husband Aurelio got the visa for the US finally. He starts at the Boston office on 1/15. She and the kids will follow in the summer once school finishes. She's quite emotional about leaving her parents.
Caroline's son Sean passed his GCSE resits, both maths and English. Huge relief for everyone. Caroline's treating him to a weekend in Paris next month.
Hassan's dad is in hospital in Beirut after a fall. Hassan is trying to get a flight out tomorrow but everything's booked. Salma's sorting the kids. Call Hassan tonight.
Thomas Johnson, my neighbour at number 12. Retired engineer, widower. His son Jonah lives in Leeds, daughter in Canada. Loves his allotment, grows prize marrows.

Demi and Carlos are going to Mexico City over New Year to meet his grandparents, first time she's met them. She's been learning Spanish on Duolingo since August. They fly December 27th, back January 6th.
Need to revise for my own Spanish B1 exam on Thursday.

Ethan's got a job interview with a firm in Amsterdam next Friday, final round, flying out Thursday night on the last KLM. If he gets it they'd relocate him in spring and his partner Natasha would look for interpreting work out there. He seemed pretty relaxed about it, said the worst case is a free weekend of canals. Ask him how it went once he's back.
Anjali passed her ACCA exams! All three. She was so worried about the tax paper. Arjun's taking her out for dinner Saturday to celebrate.
Yuki's off to Osaka on June 10 to see her parents, staying three weeks. Her mum's not well, some heart thing, so it's partly to help out. Message her while she's there to see how her mum is.
Henrik said his eldest, Ethan, passed the entrance exam for the music school in Stockholm. Starts after summer. Henrik's proud but sad he'll be boarding.
Andile Adeyemi, met at Arjun's wedding. Works as a paramedic, lives in Croydon. Has a teenage son, Vikram, who plays rugby for the county.
Remind me to ask Chantal how the grade 8 went. It was Wednesday, I completely forgot.
Kalani messaged, she got a recall for the Les Mis audition! Second round is next Tuesday. Her boyfriend is flying down from Glasgow to be there.

Spent ages with Abigail and her sister Sinead at the school gate. Abigail's husband is doing a sponsored trek in Nepal in April, she's been helping him train. Sinead's youngest has her SATs in May and is struggling with reading, they've got a tutor now. Abigail said her husband's been hinting about wanting a proper hiking watch for the trip. Should ask Sinead in a couple of weeks how the tutoring is going.
Zofia passed her citizenship test this morning. Ceremony is sometime in March. Henrik's organising drinks at theirs Friday night, I'm bringing the cake.
Sean's flight to Boston leaves at 6am tomorrow, conference till Thursday. His dog Murphy is staying with Jen. Ask Sean on Friday how the conference talk went.
Natasha's mother lives in Riga, father passed a few years back. Natasha is an interpreter, Russian and Latvian, freelances for the courts. Two kids, Jonah and Eva.

Bao's younger brother Jonah has his driving test on 12/3. Bao is giving him lessons in his Corolla and says it's terrifying. Bao also has his own PhD viva sometime in January, he's quietly panicking. Check in with Bao next week.
Okay so Adebayo is back from Lagos. Party was huge, he said nearly 200 people. His aunt gave him a stack of fabric for his wife. Follow up with him about the photos he promised to send.
Eva passed her OSCE! Had a feeling she would. She starts her first placement on the cardiac ward on Monday, nights to begin with.
Rain all day, stayed in and sorted the loft. Nothing to note really.
